claim: build_compare_pages never removed a page it stopped writing, so an orphaned comparison served stale prices. Now on the shared page ledger; terminal state is REDIRECT, never TOMBSTONE.

body.what: build_compare_pages never removed a page it stopped writing. Chinese Bayberry dropped below MIN_NURSERIES around 2026-08-11 and its /compare/ page stayed live serving that day's prices at position 9.5, with no internal link to it. Now handled by the shared page ledger (FAMILY_COMPARE); terminal state is REDIRECT, never TOMBSTONE, because every enabled species has a live /species/ page.
body.first_redirect: /compare/chinese-bayberry-prices.html became a stub on the 2026-08-22 nightly. Verified 2026-08-24: 200, meta refresh + canonical to /species/chinese-bayberry.html, heading 'Chinese Bayberry price comparison has moved', out of sitemaps/compare.xml. No other page changed state.
body.seed_defect_found_and_fixed: seed_from_disk can only read a file mtime, which for a nightly-rewritten page is last night, so all 116 live pages seeded first_seen 2026-08-20 / live_days 4 and EVERY compare page sat below ENTRY_GUARD_LIVE_DAYS (7). Because live_days only advances on a night the page is written, a page orphaning inside that window would have frozen and stayed live and stale forever, silently. Backfilled from 173 days of nursery snapshots by tools/scrapers/reseed_compare_ledger.py; 115 of 116 now clear the guard.
body.method_validated: The replay independently reconstructs chinese-bayberry's first qualifying day as 2026-06-18, identical to the date set by hand from the primal-fruits listing, and its 117 ever-qualified species match the 117 ledger entries in both directions. Re-running the committed script reports 0 pages to correct.
body.still_held_deliberately: quandong: 6 qualifying days across a 112-day span, below MIN_NURSERIES for most of its life. That is the flapping page the entry guard exists for; holding it is correct.
body.at_the_threshold: 9 species list at exactly MIN_NURSERIES=3 (2026-08-24): cherry-of-the-rio-grande, kakadu-plum, lau-lau, lawtonberry, native-river-mint, native-thyme, quandong, ruby-saltbush, saltbush. One delisting from orphaning.
body.known_gap: Nothing surfaces a held page: plan.held prints to the nightly's stdout, which nobody reads. Not ticketed, backlog is over cap.
